concerns.text: The plan falls back to the GHZ placeholder dataset (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/khaoula-ghz/guanaco-llama2-5k/resolve/main/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet`) when fewer than 50 paired plant species are obtained. This placeholder does **not** contain plant metabolite concentrations or herbivory scores, so it cannot satisfy FR‑001 (≥ 50 paired plant species) nor provide the required variables for any downstream analysis. Using it renders the scientific question unanswerable and violates the data‑appropriateness requirement.
